title: Prompt sweep logbook (personal compact sheet)
summary: Compact personal tracker for prompt variant sweeps: per-run metrics, quick cost estimates, and immediate notes to iterate on next runs.
body:
Header: prompt_sweep personal log
Columns: run_id | date | model | prompt_variant | batch | seq_len | latency_ms | tokens_out | est_cost_usd | success_rate | notes

Rows:
R001 | 2026-01-15 | redwood-7b-q4_8bit | prompt_v1 (short) | 1 | 128 | 42 | 64 | 0.0012 | 0.82 | baseline short prompt
R002 | 2026-01-17 | redwood-7b-q4_8bit | prompt_v1 (short) | 8 | 128 | 85 | 68 | 0.0009 | 0.78 | batching x8 increases latency variance
R003 | 2026-01-20 | redwood-7b-q4_8bit | prompt_v2 (context window) | 1 | 512 | 180 | 190 | 0.0035 | 0.89 | longer context improves accuracy
R004 | 2026-02-01 | redwood-7b-q4_8bit | prompt_v2 | 4 | 512 | 240 | 195 | 0.0028 | 0.88 | good throughput, kernel spill sometimes
R005 | 2026-02-10 | redwood-7b-q4_4bit | prompt_v2 | 4 | 512 | 210 | 190 | 0.0015 | 0.85 | quantized reduced cost, slight quality drop
R006 | 2026-03-05 | redwood-7b-q4_4bit | prompt_v3 (fewshot) | 2 | 256 | 110 | 140 | 0.0010 | 0.92 | added 2-shot improved success

Notes and action items:
- Quick calc: est_cost_usd computed from tokens_out * model_unit_cost (approx). Need to standardize formula in sheet.
- Hypothesis A: batching >4 hurts short prompts latency SLO; need to test with smaller seq_len distributions.
- Hypothesis B: switching to 4bit saves ~40% cost but may need calibration for specific prompt types.
- Next runs: R007: 4bit, batch=1, prompt_v3, seq_len=256 (compare). R008: 7b 8bit, batch=16, short prompt (stress test for throughput)
- Tickets/links: LINEAR-1234 (prompt-eval sweep), GH PR 447 (sweep-runner scripts), slack thread #prompt-sweeps
- Quick todo: export this to a CSV and add to personal drive folder, tag runs with run IDs in sweep-runner config.

Scratchpad:
- When time-limited, use batch=2 as compromise.
- Consider KV cache reuse for repeated prefix; add cache key to sweep-runner.
- Observed tail-latency spikes 3/5 run R006 at 98th percentile - add p95/p99 capture next time.

Raw notes (one-liners):
- R002 had jitter, maybe due to garbage collection on node-3.
- R005 mirrored small hallucination increase; lower temp in next run.

End of logbook.
